_note: Plain-language sentences for trace lines (PRD F37; W-116, D-671). Content: it changes no number and holds none (SC-2) — {out} is the line's figure and {in} what it started from, filled from the trace. byLimit is keyed by each limit's name exactly as the rule's least-of names it, and the pack refuses an entry whose limits differ. Drafted by Claude from each rule's section entry and limit names, for the owner's adoption (C5). Rules not listed show their rule id (F37.2); W-325 writes the rest.
otherLimits: Raising any of the other limits alone would not change it: {limits}.

explanations.what: {out} of your deposit interest is deducted.

byLimit.the interest: All of the interest is deducted, since it is within the limit.
byLimit.the limit: The deduction is capped by the limit for a senior citizen's deposit interest; interest above it is taxed.

explanations.what: {out} is deducted for the care of a dependant with disability.

byLimit.the amount spent or deposited: The deduction is what you spent or deposited, which is within the limit.
byLimit.the limit: The deduction is capped by the limit for the dependant's disability; spending more would not raise it.

explanations.what: {out} is deducted for the care of a dependant with severe disability.

byLimit.the amount spent or deposited: The deduction is what you spent or deposited, which is within the limit.
byLimit.the limit: The deduction is capped by the limit for severe disability; spending more would not raise it.

explanations.what: Of the {in} rent you paid, {out} is deducted.

byLimit.rent less 10% of total income: It is limited by how far your rent exceeds a share of your total income; paying more rent would raise it, up to the next limit.
byLimit.5000 per month: It is limited by the sum allowed for each month you stayed; paying more rent would not raise it.
byLimit.25% of total income: It is limited by a share of your total income; paying more rent would not raise it.

explanations.what: {out} of your savings account interest is deducted.

byLimit.the interest: All of the interest is deducted, since it is within the limit.
byLimit.the limit: The deduction is capped by the limit for savings account interest; interest above it is taxed.

explanations.what: Hotel accommodation from your employer is valued at {out} as a perquisite.

byLimit.hotel charges: It is valued at the hotel charges your employer paid, which are below the share of your salary.
byLimit.twenty-four per cent of salary: It is valued at a share of your salary, which is below the hotel charges.

explanations.what: Accommodation your employer leases for you is valued at {out} as a perquisite.

byLimit.lease rental: It is valued at the lease rental your employer pays, which is below the share of your salary.
byLimit.ten per cent of salary: It is valued at a share of your salary, which is below the lease rental.

explanations.what: The use of a conveyance from your employer is valued at {out} as a perquisite.

byLimit.the expenditure less the Table's amount: It is your employer's expenditure less the fixed amount the rules allow for official use.
byLimit.the expenditure less the higher official: It is your employer's expenditure less the higher official use you claimed with records.

explanations.what: The use of your own car, paid for by your employer, is valued at {out} as a perquisite.

byLimit.the expenditure less the Table's amount: It is your employer's expenditure less the fixed amount the rules allow for official use.
byLimit.the expenditure less the higher official: It is your employer's expenditure less the higher official use you claimed with records.

explanations.what: Medical treatment and stay abroad paid by your employer comes to {out} on this line.

byLimit.the treatment and stay: It is set by what the treatment and stay cost.
byLimit.the extent permitted by the Reserve Bank: It is set by the extent the Reserve Bank of India permits.

explanations.what: This long-term capital gain comes to {out} on this line.

byLimit.twelve and one-half per cent of the gain: It is the lower of the two ways the law allows, here the one without indexation.
byLimit.twenty per cent of the gain computed wit: It is the lower of the two ways the law allows, here the one with indexed cost.

explanations.what: {out} of your gratuity is not taxed.
